SID_ASCENT_SKILL_DESC:
Ascent skills can be used without a cooldown a set number of times during boss battles. However, they can only be used when a boss enemy with the highest max HP is present.
Hitting an enemy with an Ascent skill will not activate additional attacks or combat effects.
Ascent skills target bosses with the highest max HP first, and are unaffected by attack ignore and attack reflection effects.
The Ignore Defense and Boss Damage Increase effects from the Lv. 10, Lv. 20, and Lv. 30 Ascent skills are added to increases from basic effects.

The damage of Ascent skills is unaffected by stat changes from the following sources:
- Equipment: Hat
- Equipment: Ring
- Conditional passive skill effects
- Effects from active skills
- Link Skill effects
- Enemy attributes
- Enemy attack patterns and debuffs
- Usable and Cash items with less than 30 min. duration
